jobs.prompt: Fix nine review findings, each with a test in tests/memory-fixes.test.mjs (injected fakes only; no real process, sleep or machine read). 1 HIGH tools/autotune.mjs readAvailableMemory: exec has no default and no production caller passes one, so memory always falls back to os.freemem() (wrong on macOS, pressure reads hard nearly always). Give it a default exec that runs a fixed argv with child_process execFile (no shell, 2 second timeout, no user strings) for vm_stat and sysctl -n vm.swapusage, and read /proc/meminfo with fs.readFile (there is no 'read' binary). Keep the injectable exec for tests. A failed or unparsable read still falls back, never to infinite memory. 2 MEDIUM tools/autotune.mjs pressure: macOS grows swap on demand, so on darwin drop the swap ratio test and the swap-used test from hard (hard on darwin = available RAM under 3 GB only; swap used over 8 GB may count as soft); keep the swap tests on linux. 3 MEDIUM tools/machine-limit.mjs applyNodeTestConcurrency: only ever lower an existing --test-concurrency value (min of existing and N); add it when absent. 4 MEDIUM tools/board-keepalive.mjs: when a saved identity exists and the caller passed a different --port, fail with a clear error (the bookmark must stay valid); same port or no port reuses the saved one. 5 MEDIUM tools/autopilot.mjs: a held start (result held-memory) must record a start-ready hold timestamp and back off 60 seconds before the next try, and its log entry is marked incidental so it does not fill the log each tick. 6 LOW tools/board-keepalive.mjs: read the identity through an fd opened with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW and fstat that handle (owner, mode 0600, regular file); check the config directory is owned by the user and mode 0700 and tighten it when it is ours and looser. 7 LOW tools/watch-cli.mjs keep-up start: wrap the server start in try/catch; EADDRINUSE prints the same port-busy message and exits 1. 8 LOW tools/autopilot-ready-deps.mjs: an exception from the machine reader must mean do not hold (no failure to the caller). 9 LOW tools/autopilot-ready-deps.mjs: replace memoryAware = (env === process.env) with an explicit memoryAware option defaulting to true in production, so tests that inject env still exercise it. Keep every existing test passing.
